Priya: FYI p99 spiked for /v2/generate in eu-west at ~21:30, p50/p95 stayed normal. sample_count for that slice dropped ~3x. Suspect routing fallback to compat-lowmem.
Samir: Confirmed on my side 0min ago. Weight shift + compat-lowmem has telemetry.downsample=true so rollups are fed by a decimated stream.
Janelle: Is the console showing tdigest rollups or raw samples? That changes how we respond.
Priya: Console query is: SELECT tdigest_percentile(rollup_tdigest,0.99) AS p99, sum(sample_count) AS samples FROM endpoint_latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY time_bucket;
Alex: Downsampling + tdigest can make tails move erratically. Two short-term options: surface sample provenance/confidence in UI, or run on-demand raw-sample p99 for low-sample windows.
Samir: Practical plan: add a sample_origin field to rollups, show a "low confidence" pill when samples < 200, and a "compute raw p99" action that triggers an ad-hoc job.
Janelle: I'll mock the badge + tooltip (shows sample_source, sample_count, explanation). Also found inconsistent telemetry keys across producers (routing_policy vs route_variant) 1 will open tiny schema RFC.
Priya: I'm going to canary a toggle: set telemetry.downsample=false for compat-lowmem at 10% and compare p99 for 30m.

deploy-bot: rollout requested by Priya - config change telemetry.downsample=false for route compat-lowmem (canary 10%).
Alex: If canary shows p99 returning to baseline, it's sampling artifact. Longer-term: docs noting downsample impact on tdigest + a cheap client-side heuristic to flag p99 when sample_source != "raw".
Priya: Will post before/after charts and tenant ids used in canary in ~20m. Thanks everyone.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Janelle: Ping me with the charts and I'll wire the UX into the dashboard repo.
Priya: Will do.
